name: primality_label
description: Prime/composite classification of small integers in few-shot completion format; matched integer-copying controls.
generator_code:
import random,json,math
random.seed(0)
def isp(n):return all(n%d for d in range(2,math.isqrt(n)+1))
pools={True:[n for n in range(2,100) if isp(n)],False:[n for n in range(2,100) if not isp(n)]};items=[];controls=[]
p='Classify each integer as prime or composite.\nInteger: 2. Type: prime\nInteger: 4. Type: composite\nInteger: 7. Type: prime\nInteger: 9. Type: composite\n'
cp='Copy each integer.\nInteger: 2. Copy: 2\nInteger: 4. Copy: 4\nInteger: 7. Copy: 7\nInteger: 9. Copy: 9\n'
for i in range(120):
 n=random.choice(pools[i%2==0])
 items.append({'prompt':p+f'Integer: {n}. Type:','answer':' '+('prime' if isp(n) else 'composite')})
 controls.append({'prompt':cp+f'Integer: {n}. Copy:','answer':' '+str(n)})
json.dump({'items':items,'control':controls},open('/work/skill.json','w'))
